bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data by presenting the model with multiple-choice questions and measuring its accuracy in selecting harmless options. Also evaluated via in-house red-teaming where human annotators grade the model's responses to adversarial queries.
Evaluated using the Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data by presenting the model with multiple-choice questions to assess its ability to select harmless and unbiased options.

Evaluated as 'Political Affiliation' using the Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data (multiple-choice selection) and as 'Political Neutrality' via in-house red-teaming with adversarial prompts.

Evaluated using the Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data through multiple-choice questions targeting regional stereotypes (e.g., falsely correlating specific regions with low income levels).

Evaluated using the Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data by measuring the model's ability to choose unbiased responses from a set of multiple-choice candidates regarding jobs and professions.
